In the USA, use is restricted to those patients who are currently receiving and benefiting from gefitinib, or to those who have previously benefited from thera- py. Adverse effects include rashes and diarrhoea. There have been reports of severe diffuse parenchymal lung disease, includ- ing fatalities. There are also reports of tumour haemorrhage, sometimes fatal, after use of gefitinib in patients with head and neck cancer. Gefitinib is under investigation in the management of other solid tumours. ◊ References. 1. Culy CR, Faulds D. Gefitinib. Drugs 2002; 62: 2237–48. 2. Inoue A, et al.
